title: Assessment of intrinsic bioremediation of gasoline contamination in the shallow aquifer, Laurel Bay Exchange, Marine Corps Air Station, Beaufort, South Carolina
citation: Landmeyer, J.E., Chapelle, F.H., and Bradley, P.M., 1996, Assessment of intrinsic bioremediation of gasoline contamination in the shallow aquifer, Laurel Bay Exchange, Marine Corps Air Station, Beaufort, South Carolina: U.S. Geological Survey Water-Resources Investigations Report 96-4026, map scale 1:900.
notes: Hydrogeology/contaminant report for one small site; little stratigraphy. Ground-water chemistry tables (BTEX, MTBE, dissolved oxygen, iron, cations, anions, DIC, methane; tables 1, 3-6) and model simulation figures were not recorded because the schema has no fields for them. Fig. 2 lithologic log (boring near LB-EX-14) has a depth scale 0-15 ft but OCR does not tie descriptions to depths reliably, so intervals are recorded without tops/bottoms. Figs. 3-4 water-table maps: only a few well labels and elevations survive in the text layer; skipped. The report gives slightly different flow rates and gradients on different pages (abstract: about 60 ft/yr and 0.004 ft/ft; p. 10: 0.0046 ft/ft and about 62 ft/yr; p. 12: roughly 70 ft/yr). No pages were image-only.
